{{Top|leg}}
The '''Confederacy listening post''' was a small building maintained by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] was used for intercepting and decrypting [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] transmissions during a campaign to give the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Confederacy's army]] an advantage of knowing the Republic's plans.
